item.title: Commerce Department adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist amid Nvidia scandal
item.dc:creator: Miranda Nazzaro
item.description: The Commerce Department moved to add Megaspeed — the company at the center of Nvidia's national security scandal — to its trade entity blacklist on Monday, according to federal records. item.title: Huang profits from Nvidia's stock surge after he returns as CEO
item.dc:creator: Max Rego
item.description: Nvidia’s stock surged on Monday after Jensen Huang returned to the company, with the tech CEO set to benefit financially from the boost. The company’s stock closed at $165.05 per share, marking an increase of nearly 31.5 percent from Friday’s closing bell.
